question: Can an independent 16K MoE scheduling window combine two current 8K causal operator chunks in native16 BF16, with bounded live memory and retained top-k output order, without widening GDN/QSA chunk guards?
eligibility_evidence: Native16 BF16 producer/consumer path exists and its current model cohort is closed.
The current exact8K arena byte count is reconciled and independently reviewed in R965.
R702 examined an older FP32 Dm design; current BF16 Dm/R/gated aliases, same-binary tile backend, and separate causal/operator chunk ownership make source feasibility a concrete new question.

This is source-only architecture feasibility; no current shape or reuse measurement is required to prove owner lifetimes or bounded worst-case memory. Performance adoption still requires the queued profile and Main tests.
difference_from_held_scopes: Does not claim current route-reuse ordering or speed. Does not revive a missing-ISA/barrier/16K GDN admission scope. Reconcile the old superchunk proposal with the actual current BF16 aliases and callback phases, comparing retain-slot-order and reordered accumulation alternatives.
